capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: NuGet Assistant reads project and feed configuration files and runs dotnet package operations.
setting.allowInsecureHttpCredentials: Allow NuGet source credentials to be sent over unencrypted HTTP connections. Enable only for trusted package sources and network environments.
setting.loggingLevel: Controls the detail written to the NuGet Assistant output channel.
setting.loggingLevel.none: Disable all logging to the output channel.
setting.loggingLevel.information: Log routine activity, HTTP response status codes, and errors.
setting.loggingLevel.debug: Log routine activity and detailed HTTP requests and responses, including response bodies up to the configured limit.
setting.debugResponseBodyLimitKb: Maximum response body size, in KiB, written to the output channel when Logging Level is Debug. Set to 0 to omit response bodies.
setting.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language, or use English if it is not supported.
